patch_description: Replace the purely nonsmooth selection objective during population evolution with a staged lower-tail surrogate. Early generations reward the mean of the 12 smallest triangle areas in addition to the true minimum, encouraging configurations with many robust near-active constraints rather than accidental single-triangle improvements. The tail coefficient is annealed toward a small value late in the search, preserving focus on the actual maximin objective. The incumbent and final polishing are still evaluated and retained strictly by the true minimum area.
